summary: Tested Walk-Forward Annuale + CSV Export on Portfolio Backtest. Backend walk_forward true/false mechanics work perfectly (retrains>=2 for WF, retrains==1 for non-WF, trades list present with proper shape and entry_date<=exit_date, final_balance/net_profit/per_symbol.net consistency all verified). Frontend: portfolio-panel + walk toggle (checked by default) + run + result + 7-row symbols table + CSV export all working end-to-end. CSV downloads with correct 'apexflow_portfolio_' prefix (633 rows, 20KB, includes summary + per-symbol stats + trades + equity curve). NOTE: MetaApi currently DISCONNECTED at test time (datasource.connected=false, bot.account.real=false), so most symbols were simulated and returns differ from the expected 'connesso' baseline (obtained €47.413 vs expected ~€13.625). The 4 backend test failures are ALL a consequence of the disconnected MetaApi state - not defects in the walk_forward feature itself.

account.real=false (Tickmill Demo currency=USD balance=175162) - matches disconnected state; not a code bug but blocks tests that assert real=true.

CSV export builds a well-structured multi-section report (summary, per-symbol, trades, equity curve) with proper Italian locale formatting.

success_rate.backend: 60% (6/10 pass; 4 failures caused by external MetaApi disconnect, NOT feature bugs. Walk_forward feature tests: 6/6 = 100%)
